channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Mathematicians prove fair elections impossible
item.description: Mathematicians have proven that no electoral system can perfectly balance local representation, proportional results, and fixed parliament size.

item.title: Cancer may damage its own DNA to grow
item.description: Cancer cells use powerful genetic switches to drive growth, but this activity can harm their own DNA, leading to potential vulnerabilities.

item.title: Milky Way object accelerates protons to record energy levels
item.description: Scientists identified LHAASO J1912+1014u as a cosmic accelerator capable of boosting protons beyond one quadrillion electron volts, offering new insights into high-energy cosmic phenomena.

item.title: Dark matter's hidden force behaves unexpectedly
item.description: Dark matter particles may exert a hidden force on each other, but its effects are more surprising than anticipated. An extra attraction causes particles to cluster in ways that challenge current models.
